condition: Calling FacetGrid.map on an lmplot grid with a function that doesn't accept a marker argument (e.g. plt.axvspan) raises an AttributeError, because lmplot leaves 'marker' in hue_kws and it gets passed to every mapped function.
workaround: Call g.hue_kws.pop("marker") after lmplot and before mapping functions that don't support marker.
